display_width.description: Width (in pixels) of the virtual display for remote sessions.

display_height.description: Height (in pixels) of the virtual display for remote sessions.

display_color_depth.description: Color depth (bits per pixel) for the remote X session (typically 16, 24, or 32).

server_dpi.description: Dots per inch (DPI) for X server rendering (affects font and UI scaling).

use_display_power_management.description: Whether to enable Display Power Management Signaling (DPMS) to control monitor power states.

dpms_standby.description: Seconds of inactivity before monitor enters standby mode (only if DPMS enabled).

dpms_suspend.description: Seconds of inactivity before monitor enters suspend mode (only if DPMS enabled).

dpms_off.description: Seconds of inactivity before monitor is powered off (only if DPMS enabled).

loaded_modules.description: List of X server modules to preload (e.g., 'glx' for OpenGL support, 'dri' for direct rendering).

items.description: Name of an X server module to load.
